name: Generic STM32F103C8 (Blue Pill)
note: A DIY board on an STM32F103C8 (64 KB flash in 1 KB pages, 20 KB RAM, 8 MHz crystal), e.g. a Blue Pill. No board_id of its own: each device design picks one in the DIY range 0x3F00-0x3FFF (protocol/sysex.md 7). Layout: the gemifi bootloader (bootloader/stm32f1, BOARD=generic-stm32f103c8 BOARD_ID=<the device's>) in the first 9 KB, the app from 0x08002400 (the Code 61's address, so the same header offset and tools apply) up to the config pages, three config pages, and the update-request flag page in the last page. Copy this file to make a profile for your own board: give it a soft-power latch, a recovery button or a switched USB pull-up if it has them.

flash.note: Defaults: the flag page is the last page (0x0800FC00), the config pages the three below it (0x0800F000-0x0800FBFF), and the app ends where they start (52 KB of app). Many C8 chips have 128 KB, but only 64 KB is specified.

update_led.note: The Blue Pill's on-board LED (to 3.3 V through a resistor, so low = on). The bootloader blinks it in update mode; the app may use PC13 as an ordinary LED.
